quote: We evaluate our model on two subtasks, including attribute prediction and value extraction. The main results in Table  show that our proposed M-JAVE model based on the BERT and the Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) both outperform the baselines significantly (paired t-test, p-value < 0.01), which proves an excellent generalization ability of our methods.
